context: A dad and his young son watch a nature documentary
purpose: Teach: 国旗/比例/水平/部員/滝/ボート/高まる/翼

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: パパ、見て!大きな滝だよ!
lines.en: Dad, look! It's a huge waterfall!
lines.style: Excited child voice pointing at screen energetically

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 本当だ、すごい滝だな。あそこに小さなボートが浮かんでるのが見えるか?
lines.en: Wow, what an amazing waterfall. Can you see the little boat floating over there?
lines.style: Warm fatherly tone guiding child's attention gently

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 見える!あ、鳥が翼を広げて飛んでる!かっこいい!
lines.en: I see it! Oh, a bird is spreading its wings and flying! So cool!
lines.style: Child's voice rising with genuine wonder and delight

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: あの鳥はね、翼を水平にしたまま、ほとんど羽ばたかずに滑空するのが得意なんだよ。
lines.en: That bird is really good at gliding with its wings held horizontally, barely flapping at all.
lines.style: Patient teacher-dad explaining one fact with simple curiosity

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: へえ!パパ詳しいね。学校で習ったの?
lines.en: Wow! Dad, you know so much. Did you learn it at school?
lines.style: Innocent admiring child voice with bright curiosity

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 昔、生物部の部員だったんだよ。動物の話になるとテンションが高まるんだよなあ。
lines.en: I used to be a member of the biology club. My excitement just goes up whenever the topic is animals.
lines.style: Nostalgic warm dad voice sharing a casual memory softly

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: あ!画面に国旗が出てる!これどこの国?
lines.en: Oh! There's a flag on the screen! Which country is this?
lines.style: Curious child voice spotting something new on TV

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ブラジルの国旗だよ。アマゾンの自然を紹介してるんだ。森の広さは流れる川の長さに比例するくらい、とにかく広いんだぞ。
lines.en: That's the Brazilian flag. They're introducing the nature of the Amazon. The forest is so vast that its size is roughly in proportion to the length of the rivers flowing through it.
lines.style: Calm informative dad voice answering matter-of-factly with awe

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼくも大きくなったらアマゾンに行きたい!
lines.en: When I grow up, I want to go to the Amazon too!
lines.style: Determined dreamy child voice declaring future ambition
